title: Welcome to the Course!
body:
ENGR 1301 Welcome to the Course!

Welcome

Welcome to ENGR 1301 – Foundations of Math and Science for Engineering!

Hello and welcome! I’m excited to have you in ENGR 1301, an in-person course designed to introduce you to foundational concepts in mathematics,  chemistry and physics. Through this course, you'll strengthen your critical thinking skills and learn how to apply core science principles to engineering problems.

Course Access and Resources

You can access all of the course materials through this Canvas course. The Canvas site includes important resources to help you start the semester strong, including:

  • This course introduction module (click next to continue)
  • The syllabus
  • Tips for succeeding in the course

Please take time to explore these resources before our first class.

Communication

I’m here to support your learning and growth this semester. If you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to reach out.
